name: Functional - /query endpoint returns fallback when no evidence found
description: Checks that the /query endpoint returns the fallback message when no relevant chunks are found in the knowledge base.
input: HTTP POST request to /query endpoint (no body required); knowledge base contains no relevant data
output: QueryResponse with success=True, answer set to FALLBACK_RESPONSE, error=None, error_code=None
error_scenarios: Knowledge base returns error instead of empty result
